name: ps2_hello
title: PS2 (backend not built yet)
description: A PlayStation 2 project. It declares the target and reconfigures the tools around it; it does not build yet.
detail: The PS2's renderer shares nothing with the PS1's -- different CPU, different GPU, no ordering table, a real FPU. That is milestone M6. This template exists so the PS2 path is a real, selectable thing with a hardware profile and a toolchain check rather than a promise, and so the manager can prove it reconfigures itself per project.
